note: Ten keystone traces. Every trace is concept-local demo state and says so; nothing here masquerades as production wiring.

traces.validation_permission: Settings write on permissions scope; pattern must be non-empty and parse as a glob
traces.mutation_or_operation: Append rule {tool, match, decision, origin:'you', scope} at book tail; renumber
traces.receipt: Rule added - appended at the end of the book (strongest position under last-match-wins)
traces.ui_projection: New statute row at the tail; trace panel re-evaluated against the current book

demo_binding.interaction: data-act=rule-add after the drafting form validates

traces.validation_permission: Settings write on permissions scope; locked and managed rules pin their positions
traces.mutation_or_operation: Splice rule to adjacent index; renumber; re-evaluate the current trace input
traces.receipt: Rule moved - the book was renumbered and the trace re-evaluated in the new order
traces.ui_projection: Statute renumbering plus updated matched/winner marks in the trace

demo_binding.interaction: data-act=rule-move with data-dir, blocked against locked/managed neighbors

traces.validation_permission: read-only evaluation; no permission required beyond Settings read
traces.mutation_or_operation: Evaluate input against the ordered book (last match wins); no state change
traces.receipt: Rule test - trace explanation (e.g. rules 1, 4, and 5 match; rule 5 decides)
traces.ui_projection: Trace panel: input echo, per-rule matched marks, winner with decision word, verdict sentence

traces.canonical_owner: Plans/Permissions_System.md (access profile canon: Ask for approval / Auto accept edits / Auto / Full Access)
traces.validation_permission: Settings write; managed workspaces render the radio read-only
traces.receipt: Access profile - now <label>; the rulebook and the FileSafe floor still apply underneath
traces.ui_projection: Segmented radio pressed state; Plan/Review effect-limited note stays visible

traces.receipt: Toast: gist verified, recalled with full confidence
traces.ui_projection: Status word flips to Verified; review-note prose field disappears

traces.validation_permission: Memory write; restore requires the version to carry stored text
traces.mutation_or_operation: Swap gist.text with version.text; append a restore entry carrying the replaced wording
traces.receipt: Version restored - the replaced wording joined the history (or an honest refusal when the demo dataset lacks stored text)
traces.ui_projection: Gist text updates; version list grows by one

traces.validation_permission: Import requires diff + trust + secret + prompt-injection scans to pass; findings block with no override
traces.mutation_or_operation: Stage file, run four scans, block on findings (operation, not mutation)
traces.receipt: Re-run: both findings remain, import stays blocked / Discard: file discarded without importing
traces.ui_projection: Scan table with per-check status words and quoted injection finding; no import-anyway control exists
traces.usage_attribution: scan runs on the fast-local route class (production note; none in demo)

traces.mutation_or_operation: Set bsd.mode and mirror the planning.bsd.mode settings row
traces.receipt: Back Seat Driver - <mode label and note>
traces.ui_projection: Mode plate pressed state, per-mode note, appendix TOC status word
traces.usage_attribution: On mode raises projected reviewer spend within the usage guard

traces.validation_permission: Settings write on planning scope; ceiling clamped 1..16; sustainable-now stays read-only
traces.receipt: Goal default updated - applies to Goals started from now on
traces.ui_projection: Fan-out row updates; the operational wave warning appears whenever ceiling exceeds sustainable-now
traces.usage_attribution: Usage page owns capacity reporting; Settings only projects sustainable-now

traces.mutation_or_operation: Mark exactly one account useNext=true within the provider
traces.receipt: Use <nickname> next - future requests start on this account; running work unaffected
traces.ui_projection: Next-new-work chip moves between account rows
traces.usage_attribution: Subsequent requests attribute to the selected account

traces.validation_permission: Installation management requires proven or strong ownership confidence
traces.mutation_or_operation: Selected flag moves; shadowing recomputed per host
traces.receipt: Installation selected - <label> now resolves first; shadowing recomputed
traces.ui_projection: Selected/Shadowed chips and shadow notes update across the provider's cards

traces.canonical_owner: Plans/CLI_Bridged_Providers.md (update lifecycle) + Release owner for policy
traces.validation_permission: Ask-first policy: the click is the explicit consent; auto-idle requires proven ownership and rollback
traces.mutation_or_operation: Staged operation: updating -> verifying (seven conditions) -> ready -> activated; history entry appended
traces.receipt: Update installed - <from> to <to>, verified; dependent routes refreshed
traces.ui_projection: Card status word walks the truthful phases; verifying phase lists the checklist; history grows

traces.mutation_or_operation: Staged operation: updating -> verifying -> verification-failed -> rolled-back; two history entries appended
traces.receipt: Update rolled back - clean install but failed verification; previous generation restored (exit code alone is never success)
traces.ui_projection: Copilot card walks failure phases and renders the two-entry history
